comments.author: Elmer Glue
comments.body_html: This mod causes a massive FPS spike when entering the inventory, FPS goes from 120 to 40 for about half a second. I’m guessing it’s because this mod checks everything in the inventory for the trader marker when entering it.

comments.author: moucashi
comments.body_html: I’m aware of this issue, and I’ll fix it in the next version. For now, you can temporarily work around this problem by disabling icon rendering in the F12 menu.
